contexts.text: The acknowledgement of self...
They do not acknowledge the eternal life... the Lord they do not at all acknowledge.
That man may acknowledge and confess.
It is one thing to know, another to acknowledge; he who knows and does not acknowledge is as if he does not know, but he who acknowledges and then blasphemes and profanes is he who is here meant.

A man acquires for himself a life by all things of which he persuades himself, that is, which he acknowledges and believes... Wherefore no one can profane holy things unless he is so persuaded as that he acknowledges and yet denies... AC 1327:3.

Faith is never the knowledge of the things that are to be believed... but is acknowledgement; but acknowledgement can never exist with anyone unless he has charity and mercy. When there is charity, then there is acknowledgement, and then there is faith. AC 2049:4.
Then first do the truths of faith take root when man begins to acknowledge and believe.

To know is the first thing of regeneration, to acknowledge is the second, to have faith is the third... The worst men can know and still not acknowledge... Infidels also can acknowledge... They who have faith, know, acknowledge, and believe... To acknowledge what is of faith is a certain rational [principle] consenting, being induced to do so by certain causes, and for the sake of certain ends... There are many in Hell who acknowledge, because they have acknowledged in this life in certain states, but they acknowledge only when it is recalled to their memory that they have so preached.
The punishment of the veil is for those who, although they see truth, still from self-love are unwilling to acknowledge.
These (nations), if they acknowledge the Lord and love the neighbour, have the Lord in their worship.

Humiliation consists in the acknowledgement of himself... and in the acknowledgement that everything living and good is from the Lord; the more a man acknowledges this in his heart, the more he is in humiliation... AC 1999. AC 2327. AC 2694:end. AC 3469:2. AC 3880:7. AC 5758:2.

Faith is the acknowledgement of those things that belong to faith, and acknowledgement is never outward but inward, and is the operation of the Lord alone through charity in the man; acknowledgement is never of the mouth but is of the life; from the life of everyone may be known the quality of the acknowledgement.
Everyone acknowledges a Supreme Being when he beholds the universe.
At last acknowledges falsity for truth, and evil for good...
They do not acknowledge truth except in so far as self is in it... Such there not only do not acknowledge the truth they have professed here, but also hate and persecute it...
Inward worship consists in the affection of good and the acknowledgement of truth.

This is why a man is permitted rather to live in pleasures and cupidities... than that he should come into the knowledge and acknowledgement of interior things and profane them... If the Jews had acknowledged they could not but have profaned...
He recedes from this gift and its happiness in proportion as he recedes from the acknowledgement that it is the Lord's.
Then man is to think, acknowledge and believe, that the Lord has operated this in him.
They say that they acknowledge one Supreme Being... They do not acknowledge any God, still less do they acknowledge the Lord. AC 4733:2.
In proportion as he views Divine things from scientifics he does not acknowledge them.
Some suppose faith to be the acknowledgement of anything that is to be believed...
With those who live in what is contrary to charity, there can never be acknowledgement, but some persuasion... thus in that acknowledgement there is not the life of faith... AC 3324:5.
He (Lot) rose up to meet them = acknowledgement.
Inward acknowledgement and confession of the Lord's Divine Human and Holy Proceeding. Signified.
Good is the Lord's, and they who acknowledge this in life and faith are the Lord's... but they who do not acknowledge in life, thus not in faith, cannot be the Lord's...
He who is not conjoined to the Lord cannot acknowledge Him. That they who are not in good are not able to acknowledge the Lord, that is, have faith in Him. Signified. AC 2354:3. AC 3324:4.
By night = the last time when they are no longer acknowledged.
They who are in the life of good acknowledge the Lord, because Heaven flows in...

They who are in the life of evil are not admitted to acknowledgement itself and faith... He who once acknowledges and believes, if he returns to a life of evil, profanes what is good and holy, but he who does not acknowledge and believe cannot profane, therefore the Providence of the Lord takes care that man is not admitted further into acknowledgement itself and faith of heart than he can be kept in it. AC 3398:2.
To will evil and thence to do it, and [at the same time] to acknowledge truth in faith, can never be given.
Doctrine is said to regard rational things when no other truth of doctrine is acknowledged than what can be apprehended by reason...
What the rational acknowledges, for it acknowledges only from confirming proofs.
Mankind then no longer even acknowledged celestial and spiritual things...
They ought to think etc. from themselves, but still acknowledge that what is good and true is from the Lord.
From this state the Lord rises again with man when He is acknowledged.
Acknowledgement of Divine truth from illustration in general scientifics. Signified, Explained.
All acknowledgement and confession are from perception of influx.
Truth is learned but not acknowledged without the consent of both will and understanding... consent is acknowledgement itself.
Unless truth is received by good it is not the truth that is acknowledged, thus is not faith.
Acknowledgement that it was of the Lord alone. Signified. AC 3161:end.
The affection of good in the natural man is what acknowledges.
Good acknowledges nothing else as truth but what agrees with it. AC 3324:3.
Good and truth mutually acknowledge each other. AC 3179.
Truth must be confirmed and illustrated by many things before it is acknowledged.
Truths and goods can be acknowledged only by those whose interior mind has been opened... so far as it has been opened so far are they acknowledged.
Everyone is permitted to believe truths as he apprehends them, otherwise there would be no reception, because no acknowledgement.
It is good that receives truth to inward acknowledgement.
Before man has been regenerated, he can see with his intellectual faculty, but not acknowledge with his voluntary one.
Truths are not acknowledged, believed and imbued, unless the life is according to them...
To see, here, = to acknowledge.
Spirits mutually know each other, not from natural relationship...

Interior truth not yet acknowledged. Signified. To bring forth = to acknowledge in faith and also in act... Spiritual bringing forth is the acknowledgement and faith of truth and good... nothing is acknowledged with faith until we live according to it. AC 3909.
Indignation because interior truth was not acknowledged as outward truth was. Signified, Explained... To acknowledge truth in faith and act is to have a perception of it.
This acknowledgement and conjunction cannot exist from the outward, but only from the inward man... How the acknowledgement of truth in faith and act is produced.
Acknowledgement by means of the affection of inward truth. Signified.
The Ancients acknowledged such offspring as legitimate.
The second degree of affirmation or acknowledgement is here signified... There must be affection in acknowledgement. AC 3919. AC 3925.
To give a son = to give this truth, which is the same as to acknowledge it, for all truth that is acknowledged is given by the Lord.

This is the first general principle that is to be affirmed or acknowledged... Affirmation as well as acknowledgement is the first general principle with the man who is being regenerated, but the last with the man who has been regenerated...
A lion's whelp = the first of truth, which is affirmation and acknowledgement.
This delight cannot be dissipated by any other means than an affirmation and acknowledgement of the holy things of faith and of the good of life...
The acknowledgement of outward truth. Signified.
This is the third general means that is to be acknowledged in faith and act...
The acknowledgement of a second general truth. Signified.
Before these things have been affirmed and acknowledged...
To open the womb = to give the faculty of receiving and acknowledging goods and truths.
One who loves himself above others... and yet acknowledges and adores God...
Unless the acknowledgement of truth is from within, it is not acknowledgement.
Conscience is the acknowledgement of truth from within, and also from perception.
He first acknowledges and believes, and then denies... They who acknowledge in heart and then deny, are they who profane, not they who have not acknowledged in heart. References. AC 4289.
Until he comes to know, then acknowledge and at last believe that it is of the Lord...
Acknowledgement of these truths. Signified. To kiss = conjunction from affection, thus acknowledgement, for conjunction by good and truth involves the acknowledgement of them.
The first acknowledgement of good. Signified.
Acknowledgement. Signified. Good is what acknowledges truths.
The profanation of good by separated faith takes place when truth and good are acknowledged and believed, yet the life is contrary to them.
That the acknowledgement and adoration of the Lord's Divine Human is the life of religion...
Know now whether it is thy son's coat = whether there is likeness.
That nation did not acknowledge in doctrine, still less in life.
They who acknowledge the Lord from doctrine, and not in the life, have not the Church in them.
Know, I pray, whose seal etc. is this = that it might be known.
And Judah knew... To know = to affirm.
To bring forth (children) = to acknowledge in faith and act, and since what is acknowledged in faith and act is produced, to bring forth = production.
As man cannot only receive what is Divine, but also appropriate it to himself by acknowledgement and affection, thus by what is reciprocal...
Acknowledgement through faith. Signified.
And Joseph saw his brethren and knew them = perception and acknowledgement by the celestial of the spiritual... To know = acknowledgement from perception.
To know = to perceive, see, and thus to appear. AC 5477:end.
No one can be admitted into Heaven until he acknowledges in his heart that nothing of what is good and true is from himself. AC 5759:2.
Some Evil Spirits sought for Heavens where the Lord is not acknowledged.
Repentance and acknowledgement of the Divine things of the Church. Signified.
That he may fight against evils and falsities from himself, yet with the acknowledgement, if not at the time, still afterwards, that all the force of resisting is from the Lord.
For nothing acknowledges and receives truth but good.
They who are in evils never acknowledge that charity and its works contribute to salvation, for they cannot acknowledge what is contrary to their life...
Perception and acknowledgement of the Divine from love. Signified.
He who knows internal truths but does not acknowledge or believe them, is not inwardly in profanation.
At this day, when not anything from the spiritual world is acknowledged...
Innocence is to acknowledge that there is nothing but evil in onesself...
He who only acknowledges universally that he is a sinner... NJHD 162.
The life of the regenerate cannot be given to man before he is in a state that he can acknowledge the truths of faith, and will them in the proportion that he acknowledges them.
In this state there is the acknowledgement that is of faith.
Reception of the truths of faith does not take place by mere acknowledgement, but by acknowledgement conjoined with life, that is, as they are acknowledged in act.
When truths are known, they are as it were in the door; when they are acknowledged, they are in the court; and when they are believed, they are in the bedchamber.
When the understanding is illustrated by this Divine light, he... acknowledges truth inwardly in himself, and as it were sees it.
The unclean spirit going out = the acknowledgement and faith of truth.
To be found in the hand, when said of the truth of faith, = acknowledgement, for when that is acknowledged with faith it is found with him.

The reason why they who apply the truths of faith to evils are condemned, is that they have formerly acknowledged them, for when once the truth of faith has been acknowledged, if it is afterwards applied to what is evil, it is mixed up with falsity from evil; hence is profanation.
To serve the Lord by faith, and the world by love, thus to acknowledge truth and do evil. Signified.

The principal thing of inward worship is to acknowledge the Lord as the one and only God, and that everything good and true is from Him; those in the Church who do not acknowledge Him cannot be in good, thus not in truth; they acknowledge who are in faith and at the same time in good of life, but not they who are in evil of life... That to acknowledge and worship the Lord is to live according to His commandments.

In this Church the Lord is indeed received in doctrine, but by few with acknowledgement of heart... but the Gentiles who are converted both say with the mouth and think in the heart that they acknowledge Him as God. AC 10205:end.
Innocence is to acknowledge in heart that... none can acknowledge this in heart but they who...
To deny Divine truth when it has formerly been acknowledged and received with faith... is the sin against the Holy Spirit. AC 9818:27. AC 10287. AC 10287:2. References.
They who acknowledge what is incomprehensible, fall in thought into nature and believe in no God. EU 118.
The Lord acknowledges and receives all who acknowledge and worship God under a human form... When they hear that God is actually a man, they... acknowledge. EU 121.

To agitate = to vivify by acknowledgement, which is the first of life from the Divine with man; knowledge does indeed precede acknowledgement, but there is nothing of the Divine life in knowledge until there is acknowledgement, and then faith... this Divine life first flows in through acknowledgement.

A few words shall be said about this acknowledgement and faith... The first thing of all is to acknowledge that the Lord is the Saviour of the world... Hence that the Lord might be acknowledged, He asked them about faith. AC 10083:6. AC 10083:end. AC 10089. Illustrated.
The state after acknowledgement, which is a state of conjunction with good. Signified.
Divine truth is acknowledged in the Spiritual Kingdom, but in the Celestial Kingdom it is perceived... What is received in the intellectual part is said to be acknowledged.
Acknowledgement that it is of the Lord alone. Signified.
No appropriation of good with those who do not acknowledge the Lord. Signified.
A stranger = one who is in the Church and does not acknowledge the Lord. AC 10287.

Acknowledgement, faith and love to the Lord are the principal things of all worship within the Church, for acknowledgement, faith and love conjoin; acknowledgement and faith conjoin what is intellectual, and love, what is voluntary... He therefore who, being in the Church, does not acknowledge the Lord, has no conjunction with the Divine...
Purification or deliverance from evil through acknowledgement and faith that... Signified, Explained.
That no one can fight against the Hells but they who acknowledge and believe that all goods and truths are from the Lord.

As soon as he acknowledges and believes that goods flow in from the Lord... even when he cannot perceive the influx of goods from the Lord he still ought to acknowledge and believe that they are from Him... this acknowledgement must not be a confession of the mouth only, but of the heart.
Conjunction with Heaven by the acknowledgement that all truths and goods are from the Lord. Signified.
Conjunction of Divine, truth with those who do not acknowledge the Lord, thus who are in evils and falsities. Signified, Explained.
He who does not acknowledge the Lord is not of the Church.

For by the acknowledgement of truths communication is effected with the. Heavens, and thence the opening of the interiors of man towards Heaven... for all things that man acknowledges remain implanted, for nothing perishes in a man that has entered by acknowledgement.
That strangers are they who do not acknowledge the Lord, and will not acknowledge Him, whether without or within the Church. Illustrated.
They who do not acknowledge the Lord cannot but be in evils and the falsities of evil...

That the very essential of the Church is the acknowledgement of the union of the Divine Itself in the Human of the Lord. Signified. For thought without acknowledgement and faith is not spiritual thought.
They, as in every other Earth, acknowledge God under a human form, thus our Lord, for whoever acknowledges God under a human form is accepted by our Lord. EU 154.
To be in outward things and not in inward, is to worship outward things as holy without acknowledgement of the Lord...
To see = acknowledgement. References.
When they come to their own Society... they are at once acknowledged and received with joy.
The light of Heaven... flows into natural light... and causes man to see and acknowledge Divine truths. TCR 215:5.

Hence man acknowledges truth from inward perception... for perception comes from affection, from perception thought, and thus is effected the acknowledgement that is called faith. DLife 36. TCR 231:2.
That faith is the inward acknowledgement of truth. General article.
Faith itself is nothing but the acknowledgement that it is so because it is true...
They have an inward acknowledgement of truth who are in the spiritual affection of truth.
To be in illustration is to be in perception and thence in inward acknowledgement that this or that is true. Signified.
They call thought, separated from an inward acknowledgement that it is so, faith...
Blessed are they who have not seen and yet have believed does not mean faith separated from the inward acknowledgement of truth, but...
It follows that an outward acknowledgement without an inward is not faith... such an acknowledgement is the faith of what is unknown...
How the inward acknowledgement of truth, which is faith, can be obtained.

That inward acknowledgement of truth, which is faith, is given with those only who are in charity. General article... Thus does love produce faith which is the same as the acknowledgement of truth, and through this it produces charity...

There are also many who have not an inward acknowledgement of truth and yet have the faith of charity... but still they are in the acknowledgement of truth inwardly or in their spirit, because they are in the affection of it, wherefore when they are instructed by the Angels after death, they acknowledge truths and with joy receive them. But they who have not looked to the Lord and avoided evils from religion, inwardly are in no affection of truth, nor in any acknowledgement of it, wherefore after death, when they are instructed by the Angels, they will not acknowledge truths...
So far as man through these two faculties can he brought to acknowledge that all good and truth are from the Lord. General article. DP 90.
When he becomes wise he will acknowledge that it is not from himself...
That the acknowledgement of the Lord and the acknowledgement that everything good and true is from Him, causes man to be reformed and regenerated. Explained.

There is an acknowledgement of the Lord from wisdom, and there is an acknowledgement of the Lord from love, the acknowledgement of the Lord from wisdom, which, regarded in itself is only knowledge, is given from doctrine, and the acknowledgement of the Lord from love is given from life according to it; the latter gives conjunction, the former presence.
That this is so is also known from the common idea that... he who does not acknowledge God cannot be saved.
When a mere miracle leads a man to acknowledgement... he acts only from the natural man...
Man is not to perceive the Divine Providence, but to know and acknowledge it. General article.
They who have acknowledged only nature and human prudence constitute Hell, but they who have acknowledged God and His Divine Providence constitute Heaven. General article. DP 208.
Mistake of those who think, if I see Heaven I will acknowledge: their understanding acknowledges, but if their will does not, they still do not acknowledge...
If a man first acknowledges the truths of faith, and lives according to them, and afterwards recedes and denies them. Explained. DP 227:3. DP 231:7. Explained.

He who does not know cannot acknowledge and then deny... The Jews were unwilling to receive and acknowledge (therefore did not profane); it would have been otherwise had they received and acknowledged and afterwards denied... many of them acknowledge outwardly and deny inwardly... But they profane who first receive and acknowledge, and afterwards deny.

Their receiving and acknowledging in infancy does not matter, because then they do not receive and acknowledge from rationality and freedom... But when a man comes into the use of his rationality and freedom, if he then acknowledges truths and lives according to them, and afterwards denies them, he mixes holy and profane things together... But if a man is in evil... and afterwards acknowledges the truths of faith and lives according to them, he does not mingle holy things with profane...

They who understand and acknowledge Divine truths, yet live contrary to them. Explained... Those who not only understand, but also acknowledge, profane more grievously... for acknowledgement conjoins itself; for nothing can be acknowledged without the consent of the will. Example(s).
Profanation by those who acknowledge the Word yet deny the Divine of the Lord. Explained.
That the Lord provides that a man should not inwardly acknowledge truths, and afterwards recede. Signified.
Man should think etc. as of himself, but still acknowledge that it is from the Lord...

To believe and think (that all good and truth are from the Lord and all evil and falsity from Hell) is impossible to those who do not acknowledge the Divine of the Lord, and who do not acknowledge that evils are sins, but it is possible to those who acknowledge these two things. Explained. (The effect of making these two acknowledgements. DP 321:7.)

The acknowledgement of God effects the conjunction of God with man and of man with God. General article... Some may think that they who do not acknowledge God can be saved equally as well as those who do acknowledge Him, if only they live a moral life, saying, what does acknowledgement do? Is it not mere thought? Cannot I easily acknowledge when I know for certain... This is their language when they reason freely with an acknowledger of God. But that the acknowledgement of God conjoins. Explained.
In proportion as anyone acknowledges the Lord from the affection of love... Hence it is plain what the acknowledgement of God effects.
That everyone acknowledges God... according to the good of his life. Explained... Only they who live well can acknowledge God in heart.
Every eye shall see Him = that all who are in the understanding of Divine truth from affection will acknowledge Him. ( = that all who are in truths from good will acknowledge. AE 37.)
The rest see and understand but do not acknowledge.
Be thou faithful unto death = the reception and acknowledgement of truths...
Every universal truth is acknowledged as soon as it is heard. Explained.
There natural faith, which is only persuasion, becomes spiritual, which is acknowledgement itself.
What is life according to His commandments but actual acknowledgement?
Unless a man lives according to order, that is, unless he acknowledges God...
That salvation depends upon the knowledge and acknowledgement of God.
This man does from himself, but still acknowledges that it is from God; this he acknowledges because...
Thus in Heaven He is acknowledged as the Saviour of both worlds.
Who does not know and acknowledge that God is one? If ye acknowledge this in heart and spirit...

To believe in the Lord is not only to acknowledge Him, but also to do His commandments, for only to acknowledge Him is merely of thought from some understanding, but to do His commandments is also of acknowledgement from will... wherefore when a man only acknowledges from thought of the understanding... Such satans do they become after death who acknowledge the Lord, and do not do His commandments.
Truths that reason also acknowledges. TCR 165:2. All who do not acknowledge the Lord as the God of heaven and earth.
This everyone acknowledges.
A Divine Trinity before the world was created is acknowledged in the Christian Church.
Everything that is at this day known and acknowledged about God.
Everyone ought to confess or acknowledge that.
It is a trinity of gods that is acknowledged and worshipped.
This (trinity) they have not acknowledged in one person but in three.
Who does not acknowledge and assent when it is said?
Hence it was that they (the Jews) did not acknowledge the Messiah.
This is the reason why in heart they do not acknowledge any God.
All who acknowledge and worship any other God.
They who acknowledge and believe in one God.
For fourteen centuries the Church has not acknowledged any other faith.
The Lord... draws near to everyone as he knows and acknowledges Him, which is as he knows and does His commandments...
Unless they had first acknowledged that He was the Son of God...
The Existence of the faith of the New Church is 1. Spiritual sight. 2. The harmony of truths. 3. Conviction. 4. Acknowledgement inscribed on the mind.
Every true worshipper of the Lord, as soon as he hears any truth of faith that he had not known before, at once sees, acknowledges and receives it; the reason is that...
He appeared simple because he had acknowledged the Lord alone.

He who acknowledges the Lord, and separates charity, does not acknowledge Him except with the lips; his acknowledgement and confession is only a cold one in which there is not faith... He however who does charity and does not acknowledge that the Lord is the God of heaven and earth... does only natural charity...
It is otherwise with those who do not acknowledge Him as the God of Heaven and earth...
From a polygamous marriage is all faith that acknowledges the Lord and adopts falsities of heresy; and the faith is from an adulterous one that acknowledges three lords of one Church.

Whether faith is a legitimate offspring may be known from these three marks; the acknowledgement of the Lord as the Son of God, the acknowledgement of Him as the God of Heaven and earth, and the acknowledgement that He is one with the Father...
Wherefore he who loves the Lord's Kingdom loves all... who acknowledge the Lord...
Charity is cold now because the Church has not acknowledged the Lord God the Saviour as the God of Heaven and earth...
Heresies in which these three essentials, God, charity and faith, have been and are acknowledged...
The first table involves all things that belong to love to God, the primary of which are that we ought to acknowledge one God, the Divinity of His Humanity and the holiness of the Word...

God flows in with every man with the acknowledgement of Him in the knowledges that are about Him, and at the same time with His love towards men; the man who receives only the former... remains in knowledges without an inward acknowledgement of God... but the man who receives both... has an inward acknowledgement of God...
Silence followed such as prevails when they see and acknowledge that it is so from the inward man, but not as yet in the outward man.
Particulars which everyone acknowledges at the first hearing...
The love acknowledges it as its own...
It is believed that everyone would acknowledge at heart...
Both could perceive truths and acknowledge the truths perceived...
In this light the acknowledgement of the Lord as the God of Heaven and earth is resplendent in its glory.
That this is so everyone acknowledges...
Know and acknowledge his sins...
Actual repentance is... to know and acknowledge one's sins. General article.
There must be confession that he sees, knows and acknowledges his evils...
The evil that a man does not see, know, and acknowledge, remains.
You will then no longer be recognised by your companions, nor they by you.
Occurs. TCR 587:end. TCR 614.
The acknowledgement of the Lord. TCR 608:end. TCR 615. TCR 637. TCR 682. TCR 766. TCR 799:end.
No other inward man is acknowledged.
Everyone can see and acknowledge this.
He then recognises (his spiritual associates) there just as relatives recognise each other here.
Did not acknowledge three Divine Persons.
They acknowledged no other Son of God.
This creed has been recognised as truly Catholic by the whole Christian Church.
To acknowledge any other election is to charge Him with injustice.
That a Christian may know and acknowledge the Lord Jesus Christ. TCR 684.
That he who acknowledges the Lord and is regenerated is saved. Signified.
What true Christian does not acknowledge that...
A New Church in which God the Father, the Son, and the Holy Spirit will be acknowledged as one.
The preaching of it then becomes the acknowledgement of it.
That God is to be acknowledged, in order that anyone may have religion, or that anything of the Church may be in him.

The state of everyone there is according to the acknowledgement and worship of God; all who in heart acknowledge God, and henceforward all who acknowledge the Lord Jesus Christ [to be] God the Redeemer and Saviour, are in Heaven, but they who do not acknowledge Him are under Heaven, and are instructed there...
That Spirits could recognise themselves in my face when seen in a mirror.
Merely to know is not to acknowledge, and effects nothing.
